title: Social Choice Foundations for Simulation-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.38287v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulation-augmented generation (SAGE) is a recent technical proposal in which models simulate individuals' viewpoints at inference time in order to provide more representative answers to contentious user queries. A core challenge for SAGE is making inference-time simulation efficient without sacrificing representation quality. We introduce the first formalization of this problem, based upon an axiom from proportional clustering known as metric proportional justified representation+ (mPJR+) which is the strongest proportionality axiom known to always be satisfiable by centroid-based clustering. translated_title: 模拟增强生成的社会选择基础
translated_abstract: 模拟增强生成（SAGE）是一项近期提出的技术方案，其中模型在推理时模拟个体的观点，以便对有争议的用户查询提供更具代表性的回答。SAGE的一个核心挑战是在不牺牲代表性质量的前提下使推理时的模拟保持高效。我们首次对这一问题进行了形式化，其基础是来自比例聚类的公理——度量比例正当代表+（mPJR+），这是目前已知的、总能被基于质心的聚类所满足的最强比例性公理。我们证明，为了按比例代表 $n_H$ 个人群在给定提示上的观点，我们只需创建 $n \ll n_H$ 个个体的模拟，并且在推理时，只需根据提示动态路由到这些模拟中的 $k \ll n$ 个。这种双重缩减仍然能够产生近似比例代表……
tldr: 本文首次基于比例聚类公理mPJR+对模拟增强生成（SAGE）问题进行了形式化，证明只需模拟远少于总人数的个体并在推理时动态路由到其中更少量的模拟，即可实现对人群观点的近似比例代表。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first formalization of simulation-augmented generation (SAGE) based on the mPJR+ proportionality axiom, proving that simulating only n ≪ n_H individuals and dynamically routing to k ≪ n of them at inference time suffices to achieve approximately proportional representation of a population's viewpoints.
